title: Opaque comparisons acquire exact coordinates under a quadratic-permutation promise
status_authority: Selected source bytes and producer-reported internal reviews are preserved. This integration does not promote correctness, novelty, physical capability, priority or practical advantage.
reported_status: The Ultra proof presents an exact finite-oracle acquisition theorem and an internal whole review. The selected fresh-median construction uses O(n^3 log(n/delta)) comparisons; finite runs and the stronger quotient-preparation supplement are separately identified.
scientific_scope_status: For an unknown quadratic Boolean permutation Q on n-bit objects, the learner receives exact chosen-pair comparisons in lexicographic Q order and the quadratic-permutation promise. The theorem reports exact acquisition of Q coordinates and reusable inverse/conditional-prefix operations with a posteriori complexity b(Q). The quotient supplement and measured core-table algorithm are distinct versions.
